amendment.reason: Version 1 allocated haplotype nodes independently and therefore split the two homologues of many simulated diploid individuals across FREQ, REF_LAI and DONOR.
amendment.impact: M28-M28D remain technical reproducibility evidence, but their independence claims and scientific performance estimates are superseded. M14-M25 on real DNABR data are unaffected.

estimand_for_later_stage: Paired reduction in bp-weighted macro ancestry-dosage MAE for BR relative to BS, with B0 comparisons and boundary metrics secondary.

software.ancestry_engine: msprime DTWF for 50 generations followed by StandardCoalescent
software.mutation_rate_source: AmericanAdmixture_4B18 catalog value from Gravel et al. 2011

region.coordinate_policy: Rebase bp and cM to zero for simulation and restore the GRCh38 bp offset in exported files. Do not extrapolate outside the authenticated map interval.

source_populations.interpretation: Generic source populations in AmericanAdmixture_4B18. ASIA is not NAM and must never be relabelled as NAM.
source_populations.rationale: Preserve the published scenario instead of mixing it with DNABR ancestry proportions.

frequency_diploids.purpose: Estimate AC, AN, minor allele, MAC and MAF only.
frequency_diploids.arithmetic: AN=600; MAC 2-5 satisfy MAF<0.01 and MAC 6 does not.

pools.disjunction: Assign complete diploid individuals to exactly one of FREQ, REF_LAI or DONOR; only then expand each individual to its two sample nodes.
pools.donor_reuse_policy: At each recombination event choose a new donor haplotype without replacement within the technical smoke. Future M28E splits must additionally keep both homologues of every DONOR individual in one role.

rare_definition.statistics: Recompute AC and AN from phased genotypes and orient to the minor allele rather than assuming ALT is minor.
rare_definition.independent_carrier_policy: M28E must require at least two independent carrier individuals or family components using TRAIN only; MAC>=2 alone is not sufficient.
rare_definition.target_independence: TARGET genotypes and truth cannot filter or rank sites.

mosaic_generation.event_process: For each target haplotype, draw recombination events as a Poisson process with mean pulse_generations times map length in Morgans.
mosaic_generation.event_action: At every event redraw ancestry and donor; record an LAI boundary only when ancestry changes.
mosaic_generation.truth: Half-open segments cover both target haplotypes without gaps or overlaps.

seeds.role_seeds: Derive ancestry, mutation, pool-allocation and mosaic seeds with numpy.random.SeedSequence and record them.
seeds.interpretation: Re-use is limited to a technical paired correction smoke on already consumed roots. These roots remain permanently excluded from M28E DEV and VALID.

gates.S0_MAP: Map identity and coordinates are exact.
gates.S1_REPRODUCIBILITY: The same root and contract reproduce byte-identical scientific outputs.
gates.S2_DISJUNCTION: Every source individual has exactly two nodes in one ancestry and exactly one role; node and individual intersections across roles are empty.
gates.S3_PHASE_AND_TRUTH: Genotypes are phased and truth covers both haplotypes completely.
gates.S4_RARENESS: Rare alleles reproduce from FREQ only with correct minor orientation.
gates.S5_EXPOSURE: Each ancestry has non-zero median observable rare evidence per true tract.
gates.S6_SCOPE: No LAI fitting, scoring, effect estimate, parameter selection or TEST opening occurs.

stop_rule: Stop on any failed gate. Do not use these technical roots to select M28E performance parameters, estimate an effect, set SESOI or size DEV/VALID.

later_comparator_not_yet_authorized.primary_metric: paired bp-weighted macro ancestry-dosage MAE; BR versus BS is the key rare-specific contrast
later_comparator_not_yet_authorized.replication_plan: Not frozen. It must be estimated prospectively after the corrected technical smoke and a separate M28E PRE.
